messages:
Marta: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone tie-out for Autoscale & Latency. Who can confirm shipped vs slipped and next steps? Please keep bullets.

Leo: Shipped: canary autoscaler (tiered pools) rolled to 2 regions. Observability dashboards wired. :tada:
Leo: Slipped: full cross-region failover playbook — ran into IAM edge cases.

Ava: Shipped: batching heuristics v1 (per-route smart batching) — reduced p99 by ~12% on test traffic. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/834
Ava: Blocker: need model team to expose token length histograms for a few prod models (see comment on PR). @Ravi can you follow up?

Ravi: Ack — will ask model-onboard team to attach histograms. ETA EOD Thurs. Also slipped: KV-cache eviction tuning experiments — need more perf data.

Sam: QA: ran replay on dedicated traffic window — found one regression in edge-case seq=0 for Llama-2-13B quant path. Filed bug #4212. Patch queued.
Sam: Test plan for canary rollback added to incident playbook.

Marta: Action items so far:
- @Ravi follow up with model-onboard for histograms (EOD Thu)
- @Ava continue KV-cache perf runs and post results (Mon)
- @Leo finish failover IAM doc and assign reviewer (Fri)
- @Sam land seq=0 patch and run canary smoke (ASAP)

Leo: Small note — customer A will start dedupe tests next week; we should reserve burst capacity for 24–48h window. I can allocate but need approval from finance for bump.

Marta: @Leo please add cost estimate to the thread. I'll loop in finance if >$5k.

Ava: quick snippet to reproduce KV eviction flakiness locally:
```
# repro
python infra/tests/kv_evict.py --model r2 --threads 16 --seq-length 4096
```

Ravi: Heads-up — if histograms aren't available, we'll fallback to sampling via proxy. That adds ~0.4% tail latency on sample workload. Documenting tradeoff in a gist and will post link.

QA-bot: Test run summary (2026-02-15T09:12Z): canary 2-region: pass (99.7% requests ok), seq=0 regression detected, batching v1 latency improvement confirmed.

Marta: Thanks all. Final ask: everyone post a one-line owner update by EOD today in this thread (shipped / slipped / next step). I'll consolidate into the quarter slide deck.

Leo: Owner update: shipped canary autoscaler; slipped failover doc; next step cost estimate to finance.
Ava: Owner update: shipped batching v1; slipped KV-cache tuning; next step run longer perf sweep Mon.
Ravi: Owner update: waiting on histograms from model team (ETA EOD Thu); next step implement sampling fallback if needed.
Sam: Owner update: filed bug #4212 for seq=0; patch queued; will run canary smoke after patch.
Marta: Consolidated — I'll add to deck and ping stakeholders (PM + Sales ops). Thanks :rocket:
